title: The subway
content: Guys due to a turn of dream events in which my ride bailed, I ended up riding the underground trains in mall world last night in my pyjamas, which was an oversized blue t shirt and flip flops. It was so unpleasant. I ended up at a station with a bunch of really cheap overpriced clothing stores (think Ed hardy style sweatpants for 39.99) - there was even a store that sold boxing shorts? Too expensive for me to buy clothes so still in my pjs I headed out into a fairground past two women dressed as fairies who were putting sparkles directly into their eyes. Mallworld is wild.
